Launch an Interactive Fit-Explorer Dashboard

dash.Rd

Launches a local, interactive Quarto dashboard for exploring a fitted CoSparTA / CoSparTA_missing object. The dashboard shows the temporal factor pattern (plot_time_factors), the channel factor pattern (plot_channel_factors), a component-weight chart, and a table of covariate (gamma) coefficients, all restricted to a set of components selected via checkboxes.

Usage

dash(fit, channel_names = NULL, time_labels = NULL)

Arguments

fit

A fitted object returned by CoSparTA or CoSparTA_missing.

channel_names

Character vector of channel labels, forwarded to plot_channel_factors. Fixed at launch; not adjustable from the dashboard. Default NULL.

time_labels

Numeric vector of time-axis labels, forwarded to plot_time_factors. Fixed at launch; not adjustable from the dashboard. Default NULL.

Value

Invisibly, the path to the temporary .qmd file used to launch the dashboard. Called primarily for its side effect of starting the dashboard server.

Details

The dashboard is a Quarto document (format: dashboard, server: shiny) bundled with the package at inst/dashboard/cosparta_dashboard.qmd. dash() saves fit (together with channel_names and time_labels) to a temporary .rds file next to a copy of the template, then calls quarto_preview, which starts a local Shiny-backed server and opens a browser tab.

This call blocks the R console for as long as the dashboard is open — the same behavior as shiny::runApp(). That is expected, not a bug. Stop the server (e.g. Escape in RStudio, or Ctrl+C in a terminal) to return control to the console.

The only interactive control is a checkbox group for selecting which components (ranks) to display; all four panels re-render from that selection. channel_names and time_labels are read once at launch and are not exposed as dashboard inputs.

Requires a local Quarto CLI installation. If it is not found, install it from https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/.

See also

plot_time_factors, plot_channel_factors, CoSparTA, CoSparTA_missing

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fit <- CoSparTA(X, K = 3, Xcov = Xcov)
dash(fit, channel_names = c("Retail", "Social", "Search"),
     time_labels = seq(0, 600, length.out = 20))
} # }
